mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES stops falling and remains near its current level, commuting-linked daytime foot traffic will stabilize and keep RETAIL_REC from declining further over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is lower over the next 28 days than over the last 28 days while WORKPLACES remains flat or improves.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in RESIDENTIAL alongside weaker TRANSIT implies more time spent near home and fewer discretionary trips, which will push RETAIL_REC down within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises above 18 points while TRANSIT stays below -25 points
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within 14 days after RESIDENTIAL exceeds 18 and TRANSIT remains below -25.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained improvement in GROCERY_PHARM indicates routine local errands are recovering first, and that spillover will lift retail-and-recreation visits over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to increase over the next 28 days despite GROCERY_PHARM staying above its current level.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT recovers while WORKPLACES remains depressed, the city is reactivating travel without full job-site return, which will not support retail visits and will keep RETAIL_REC negative over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises above -25 before WORKPLACES rises above -10
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days even though TRANSIT improves before WORKPLACES does.

mechanism_narrative: A short-run improvement in PARKS acts as a weather-and-leisure proxy; when outdoor activity rises, retail and recreation follows within one week as people bundle errands and outings.
candidate_trigger: PARKS increases by at least 3 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase in the week after PARKS rises by 3 or more points.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays elevated and WORKPLACES remains below baseline, people substitute toward home-based activity and delay discretionary shopping, reducing RETAIL_REC over two to four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days while RESIDENTIAL stays above 17 and WORKPLACES stays below -15.

mechanism_narrative: A threshold recovery in TRANSIT above its recent trough signals easing movement frictions; once that crossing occurs, retail visits should improve within four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises by at least 3 points from its current level and stays above -30 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains flat or declines over the next 28 days after TRANSIT moves above -30 for two straight weeks.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM strengthens while PARKS weakens, routine indoor errands are crowding out leisure trips, and retail-and-recreation mobility will fall over the next month.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises above 4 while PARKS falls below -10
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days even though GROCERY_PHARM stays above 4 and PARKS stays below -10.
